messages:
maria: Morning — final announce check. Need ENG signoff on changelog, published docs link, canary windows. Webinar is Tue 10am PT (we'll share the join link). Can we do a canary 48h before global? @sanjay @liz

sanjay: on it. changelog PR number?

maria: PR in docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/patchwave/changelog PR#482. Please confirm entry for `v1.3.2` includes the benchmark notes and the small breaking note about the KV cache header.

liz: I can review the changelog now. quick q: does `v1.3.2` require config migration? sanjay?

sanjay: small change — one-line migration: set `KV_CACHE=true` for dedicated pools. i'll paste snippet.

sanjay: ```
config:
  kv_cache: true
```

liz: LGTM. canary slot preference: Thu 14:00 PT for a 2h window? ben?

ben: Thu 14:00 PT works for SRE. We'll monitor latencies and memory. rolling percentages: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2h.

omar: inbound leads — marketing will route any high-intent trial signups during canary to the "priority-engage" flow. maria, can you confirm webhooks and tags?

maria: yes — inbound leads get Zendesk tag `canary-interest` + webhook to /hooks/priority. Flow doc: https://redwood.ai/marketing/canary-leads

ben: reminder: pin fallback model variant `gptx-compat` in routing policy in case of OOMs.

sanjay: we'll add the fallback and set autoscale min to 2 nodes during canary. also will enable extra KV cache logging for 3h post-deploy.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for v1.3.2 (canary) at 1763503200 (Thu 14:00 PT). Status: queued.

maria: perfect. last ask — docs link we surface in the release post should be the stable docs URL (not the PR). that's https://redwood.ai/docs/patchwave/v1.3.2. liz please confirm we redirect PR URL to stable on merge.

liz: yes, we'll update the docs site on merge and add a short "what's new" blurb with the benchmark summary. maria, can you paste the benchmark blurb?

maria: Benchmark blurb: "Adaptive batching + KV cache reduces median token latency by 38% and unit cost by 22% on conversational workloads (internal R20 benchmark)." Use that short phrase for blog/social.

ben: all set from infra side. I'll be in the release war room during canary. I'll ping #release-war-room at T-15.

maria: thanks everyone :rocket:
